_On 7/27/2026, Fluxco landed $26 million in Seed funding from 8VC, Congruent Ventures and Cubit Capital._

_Proceeds Purpose_

The company plans to use the capital to support the growth of its software platform and scale its operations in the electrical transformer procurement market.
